reviews.comment: Class itself is very easy, 90% of your grade split between 3 essays that are literally just over the slides and peer reviews for those essays, other 10% comes from iclicker attendance, not hard and he is a good prof, only negative is it takes a while to grade and can be inconsistent.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class was very  boring. Random iclickers so you have to go to class. TAs graded I think 1 of the 3 essays but I ended up with an A so. Class was very easy and topics were so simple. I think Mr. Dabney would thrive in a more interesting class.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Boring lectures but easy grade. Just 3 papers all of which are graded based off peer review. Go to class because it's 10% participation and there are random iClicker's.
Pretty boring, but easy. I think you'd be hard pressed to actually do poorly in this class

Dr. Dabney truly cares about the subject matter and the class. Even if the class size is large, and there is an online section, there are discussion boards for each assignment that is very active and engaging. This is one of those courses where he will keep tying how we would use the learning content for research purposes. Highly recommend!

The lectures are very, very boring. Expect the TAs to dole out inconsistent grades on weekly papers since they loosely follow the syllabus rubric that is very open-ended to begin with. Also, expect most of his examples to involve cancer: he's just been in the field for so long that it's first thing he comes up with.

It's a class. Go to the lectures, although there's a few you can get by with without going that aren't the guest speaker recording lectures. Probably would've been more interesting having a class almost entirely of guest speakers. Doesn't really respond to emails. Grading is wildly inconsistent (although that's more a TA issue than a prof issue).

Overall a good professor but lectures can be a bit boring (although I think this could be due to the course itself). Go to class, listen to the lecture, and write a summary of the lecture. This is pretty much the only thing you do in this class. Incredibly easy A. I feel as though I would like this professor more in a more interesting class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: i thought he was a good professor!! the class was very easy since there was only one lecture and journal a week with two 1000 word papers. the grade is mostly reliant on how the TAs grade the journals and papers.

Get ready for the most boring class of your life. As a Stat major you don't have much of a choice, as 182 is required and Prof. Dabney is likely going to be your only option. I just want to let any incoming freshmen know that Statistics is actually fascinating; don't judge it off of Dabney's excruciating introduction.

The class itself was very easy with a lecture once a week and a 500-word essay due at the end of the week. I will say that Dabney is very monotone and sometimes his lectures make me want to fall asleep but besides that he is a very chill guy. The main thing is that the TAs grade your essays, and their grading criteria IS NOT clear.

A 500-word journal paper is due every week, along with two 1000-word papers. The TAs graded the journals and they did not make the grading criteria clear, with very inconsistent feedback. However, this class is fairly easy if you keep up with the papers.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is super easy! A journal due every week and two longer papers. The content of the class is super basic, mostly just concepts and R programming. I got ahead on my journals and papers and completed them using the lectures he had posted on Canvas. Trust me, you'll get an A.

STAT182 is an easy class and some of the material in class is pretty interesting, but he has such a monotone voice that it makes statistics pretty boring. The class was probably better when it was guest lectures instead
Dabney is a fairly boring teacher, but the material in STAT182 is interesting enough to make up for it. I think the class with guest speakers in the past would have been more interesting

Not a bad class at all. Journal due every week (about 500 words) and a midterm and final paper (about 1000 words each).The statistics you learn is very basic, mostly just concepts and the coding language R. He gives lots of examples and lectures don't drag on endlessly.
reviews.ratingTags: So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures once a week with an essay summorizing the lecture. Grading is incredibifibly lax and the prof is understanding and personable

Pretty easy stats lecture. Just make sure to attend class and then do the journals. Definitely put some effort into the journals, the TAs can be a little nitpicky on grammar. The papers aren't bad, you definitely have to do some research on the topics, but it's nothing unreasonable, and you have plenty of time to write them.

It is clear that Dr. Dabney is passionate about statistics and teaching his students. Very monotone and hard to keep attention in class, but overall learned a lot from him. Weekly journals (around 500 words) which are not bad if you attend lecture and work on them there, a long with two 1,000 words papers, which are graded by his TAs.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Dabney is an extremely knowledgeable and caring professor. He explains concepts well. His grading scheme is fair, 25% hw, 25% midterm 1, 25% midterm 2, 25% final. Exams are multiple choice, free response and matching. Be ready to closely read the handouts, they are dense. Pay attention to details as they can be asked in MC. Highly recommend!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: There were weekly assignments due that were not time consuming, and 2 papers which were graded fairly. He is a very nice guy (he speaks very monotone), but some of the guest lecturers were boring, not his fault. I hope I get him again!
Prof. Dabney is a first-rate teacher and scholar. STAT 646 wasn't easy, but the lectures and exercises were so well organized that I learned a ton and was ultimately successful in the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Good experience over all. Highly recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This was an online distance course and he made it very accessible for all students on campus and off. His homework is related to the lectures and grades fairly and quickly. He and the graduate assistant are available to help outside of class and seem to enjoy helping others learn. He is enthusiastic about the topic and wants students to succeed
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Awesome guy: super caring, relaxed, and you can tell he loves the subject. He was always super understanding and willing to help out, and you can tell he knows that the pandemic effects different people in different ways. Overall, 10/10 would recommend Dr. Dabney.

Dr. Dabney was an amazing professor. This was by far my favorite class of the semester. He did an outstanding job of creating a safe and comfortable environment in the classroom and was very concerned about our levels of understanding and provided helpful Q&A sessions to allay any confusion or concerns with course material.
Great professor who is very knowledgeable and fair

Amazing professor. I only took the beginning statistics class that was writing-oriented but if you ask, he will gladly commit time to make sure that your writing is what it needs to be and will offer a lot of help without feeling intimidating. He is a bit soft-spoken but he is extremely nice.

Dabney's lectures were very easy to follow because he goes into detail for each topic. He seems to care that you understand the material more than other professors I've run into. Solid choice for a class!

He is one of the best and inspiring professors I have ever taken class. I can take 9 credits outside my department and I have taken all of them for dabney's class. He makes sure you understand the concepts. His classes are a very good blend of theory and programming.
Awesome professor!  One of the best ever.  Takes the time to make sure you understand the material, and gives TONS of practical uses for the techniques.
He is one of the best professor's I ever came across in my life. He will make you love statistics.
Professor Dabney is a great prof. He cares about students and the subject he is teaching. He is always willing to help and grades very fairly. His test are very fair. I would highly recommend him.

Dr.  Dabney is great professor. If you have a question feel free to ask, especially when you need help with you R code. There is a lot of use of R in this course, so get ready to spending some nights  righting your code.
